narration.full_text: Alright students, time for some more questions to test your understanding of Control and Coordination! Let's dive right in. First question: What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise? Take a moment to think about it. And the answer is: All information from the environment is detected by receptors. When receptors do not work properly, information from the environment cannot be detected, and our body cannot respond accordingly. Next up: Draw the structure of a neuron and explain its function. This one requires a bit of drawing and explanation. Here's a breakdown of its function: The information is acquired at the end of the dendrite tip of a nerve cell. The information travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end. Moving on to plants: How does phototropism occur in plants? Consider the chemical compounds involved. The chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination in plants are called plant hormones or phytohormones. Auxin controls growth, Gibberellins help in stem growth, Cytokinin promotes cell division, and Abscisic acid inhibits growth and causes wilting of leaves. Last question for this round: Which signals will get disrupted in case of a spinal cord injury? Think about the different types of actions the spinal cord controls. In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord, and signals coming from nerves as well as signals coming to receptors will be disrupted. Great job, everyone! Keep practicing and reviewing these concepts.

visual_beats.description: Title: More Questions: Control and Coordination
Question: What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise?
Answer Part 1: All information from environment is detected by receptors.
Answer Part 2: When receptors do not work properly then information from environment cannot be detected and our body cannot respond accordingly.
Question: Draw the structure of neuron and explain its function.

Answer: (i) The information is acquired at the end of the dendrite tip of a nerve cell (ii) The information travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end.
Question: How does phototropism occur in plants? Answer Part 1: The chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination in plants are called plant hormones or phytohormones.
Answer Part 2: Auxin: Controls growth. Gibberellins: Helps in growth of stem. Cytokinin: Promotes cell division. Abscisic acid: Inhibits growth, wilting of leaves.
Question: Which signals will get disrupted in case of spinal cord injury?

Answer: In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord of nervous system and no by the brain. In fact, nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain. In case of any injury to the spinal cord, the signals coming from the nerves as well as signals coming to the receptors will be disrupted.
